_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in a coil with unresolved divergences and no CVD/funding/fear-greed breaker, so the base-rate honest call is range continuation inside Hope (±1 only).
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/coil; narrative supplies inflow fact without a forward phase or direction; consensus adopts analyst HOLD and keeps phase at Hope (Complacency illegal).
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with funding near flat and fear/greed holding roughly 50-65
next_move.invalidated_if: A range break on a CVD or funding impulse, or fear/greed leaving 45-65 as netflow and skew extremes resolve through price
